verdict.rationale: GitLab documents its REST API v4 with semantic versioning, a dedicated deprecations page instructing users to review and adapt to upcoming changes, and an OpenAPI 3.0 spec auto-generated from code for accuracy. This directly matches the story of versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of the deprecation policy's real-world reliability, and no explicit long-term support timeline (e.g., how many versions/months deprecated features remain available).
